Author: TheKHD5
Name: Bestiary Nav
Description: Click a Bestiary entry to find its capture location or duty. Highlight nearby uncaptured beasts and optionally travel to them with Lifestream and vnavmesh. /bnav opens the Bestiary; /bnav config opens settings.
Changelog:
- Add optional usage reporting under Settings → Privacy; off by default.
- Share only a random installation ID and plugin version, with an ID reset control.
- Add a private maintainer dashboard for activity, versions and downloads.

Full details on GitHub repo:
